parameters.name: CheckUrl
parameters.description: The URL that is used for health checks.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name that you want to add. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

Wildcard domain names are supported. A wildcard domain name must start with a period (.), such as .example.com.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the system automatically assigns the ID of the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

*   **domestic**: Chinese mainland
*   **overseas**: outside the Chinese mainland
*   **global**: global

Default value: **domestic**.

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: The information about the addresses of origin servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn add-dcdn-domain --domain-name example.com --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --sources content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80 --check-url www.example.com/test.html --scope domestic --top-level-domain yourTopLevelDomain --tag Value=value Key=env --function-type routine --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn AddDcdnDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --CheckUrl 'www.example.com/test.html' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyuji4b6r400' --Scope domestic --DomainName 'example.com' --FunctionType routine --Tag.1.Value value --TopLevelDomain yourTopLevelDomain --Sources 'content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80'
